WEATHER FORECAST FOR 16 August 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 15 August 2026
Several spells of showers will occur in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western province and
in Kandy, Nuwara-Eliya, Galle and Matara districts.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and
Batticaloa districts after 2.00 p.m.
Fairly strong winds of about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Northern, North-central,
North-western and Southern provinces and in Trincomalee District.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

මුහුගේ සතවභ වය:

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 15 August 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers may occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from Chilaw to Matara
via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be westerly to south-westerly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph.
Wind speed can increase up to (50-60) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and Puttalam, and from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota.
Wind speed can increase up to (45-50) kmph at times in the other sea areas around the island.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Chilaw via Mannar and Puttalam, and
from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota will be rough at times. The naval and fishing communities
who are engaged in fishing and naval activities in the above sea areas are requested to be vigilant
in this regard.
The other sea areas around the island may be fairly rough at times.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.
